text:
Turbines
Technical Procedure
Rifox
Bremen - Germany
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed 
 every 2000 equivalent operating hours EOH as indicated in the title block.
The water vapor separator separates the water vapor in the air of compressor 
 and drain it .
Technical Data:
The first draft initiated by eng. Mostafa Hamza, accepted by eng. Hamdy EL-Melegy, revised by EDEPC inspection and quality control eng. Abouda EL-Banna,and 
 certified by accountant Mahmoud 
Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin and financial inspection, quality control General 
Director and supervisor of inspection and quality control head sector.
This document is accepted by eng. Samir 
Abd El Gilil EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant; Mahmoud 
Mohamed Soliman; EDEPC admin and financial inspection, quality control General 
Director and supervisor of inspection and quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A 
 work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmets shoes, gloves, etc
Turbine must be shut down.
The water vapor separator must be isolated mechanically by closing inlet and 
 outlet.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluids (WD 40 Kerosine Turbosol).
Rags.
Compressor up to 10 bar.
Boiled Water.
Work to be Carried Out
Dismantle the water vapor separator
Pull off the water vapor separator out side it's position.
Clean Pipes and hoses by blowing through.
Clean the inside filter of water vapor separator by any suitable agents 
 (Kerosene or Turbosol or benzene).
Assembly the water vapor separator with its, inside gaskets
Insert the water vapor separator in its correct position.
Tighten the water vapor separator from two sides in it's pipe by two hexagonal 
 nuts using wrench 41.
Check the leakage and treat it by re-tightening the water Vapor Separator.
